uncertain.what: East facade wall gap at x 6.18, y 7.62..8.20 (0.58 m): a through-wall ATM unit (A-GENM 'ATM Machine-V26', with fascia and canopy outside) fills it. I left it out because no person or light passes through. If the 3D model must cut the facade for the ATM, use a=(6.1905,7.62), b=(6.179,8.1999), wall 0.10. A detector will likely report a passage here.

I listed all 8 facade curtain-wall panels (A-GLAZ-CURT System Panel GLAZED) as full-height glass walls. The plan shows no sill heights, so any that sit on a sill would be windows. Panel centres: (-0.03,-9.13), (2.23,-9.13), (4.02,-8.53), (5.86,-6.38), (6.24,-4.78), (6.17,-1.73), (6.11,1.62), (6.05,4.40).

B1-08 is two separate DOOR-CW_PIVOT door blocks (2568134 and 2568539) in the SE chamfer, with no mullion between them. I counted them as ONE double pivot opening, 1.603 m with frame or 1.503 m clear. A scorer that counts door blocks would expect two openings of 0.77 and 0.73 m.

Width rule for doors in glazed screens and curtain walls (B1-07 to B1-12): a and b are on the adjoining glass or solid wall elements, so the jamb mullions count as the door frame. The clear widths between the mullions are 0.05 m smaller (0.10 m for B1-08 and B1-09). Each opening's notes give the clear width. Centres are the same under either rule.

B1-03 is a 1.205 m gap in the y -5.05 wall. Nothing is drawn in it except an A-FLOR threshold line, so I labelled it a passage. The two wall pieces are 14 mm apart in y. If a door was intended, it is missing from the model.
B1-06 sits in a frameless screen that is drawn as 10 mm glass only, so I gave wallThickness 0.01. A detector that expects 100 mm glass walls may measure a different thickness here.
Door heights are unknown for the glass doors and pivot doors (B1-06 to B1-12): their block names are 'TYPE 1' or 'D3 - PL03', with no height. The other doors carry 2400 in their names.

rejected.reason: East facade wall gap y 7.62..8.20 is filled by a through-wall ATM. Equipment, not a door, window or passage (see uncertain).
10 cm slot between the SW corner column (x -5.23..-4.93) and the south facade wall (starts at x -4.8304), y -9.18..-9.08. A modelling joint, too narrow to pass.
Enclosed void under the lift shaft (x -3.48..-1.63, y -9.08..-8.73) between two parallel wall stubs. The wall-gap search paired them, but no wall is interrupted.
The two party-wall leaves (x about -5.8..-4.93) break only at the concrete columns (y -6.52, -3.41, 0.00, 3.30), which fill the breaks. The 0.1 m cavity between the leaves is not an opening.
Q-CASE ADJUSTABLE CUPBOARD DOOR / ADJUSTABLE DRAWER / TALL CABINET blocks and their swing arcs along x -3.46 (y -4.6..5.0). Casework, not openings.
The west end of the ATM-lobby south wall (y -5.63, x 5.25..6.20) faces the open lobby. A wall that ends in open space.
The south end of the free-standing glass screen east of the BA / BE desks ends in open space.
The east end of the meeting-room north wall is a corner open to the facade-door lobby, with no wall line continuing. Not an opening.
The south end of the north toilet's east wall faces a 1.08 m wide corridor bounded by the perpendicular meeting-room north wall. A corridor, not an interrupted wall.
The east end of the manager's south wall is its corner with the east glass wall, with the open BA / BE area beyond. Not an opening.

The wall-gap search also paired faces inside the curtain-wall panels (between the mullions) and inside the 100 mm glass-wall envelopes (for example (4.78, 1.14..3.16) and (6.22, -5.45..-4.11)). These are glass walls, not openings.
The second pivot door block (2568539) is merged with 2568134 into the single double-door opening B1-08, because the two leaves meet with no mullion between them.
The stair drawn outside the north wall (x -4.0..0.4, y 11.75..12.65) and the L1 stair (x 1.4..4.2, y 7.9..9.6) are stairs, with no wall openings.
The A-DETL circle (radius 1.0 m) in the entrance lobby is a floor or ceiling feature, not an opening.
The wall stubs at x 1.35..1.70, y 9.33..9.63 by the stair stick out from the side of the slanted 300 mm wall. No gap.
